Question 12
?

If Y={2,4,6,…,100}, which collection of subsets of Y is a partition of Y?

a
{{4,6,8,10},{10,11,12,…,100}}
b
{{2,4,6,…,40},{42,44,46,…,60},{62,64,66,…,100}}
c
{{1,2,3,…,100}}
d
{{2,4,6,…,40},{80,82,84,…,100}}
e
{{2,4,6,…,40},{20,22,24,…,100}}
Submit
